formato: CourseGradingConfig.exam_script (apps/practice/conversa/exame.py, validar_guiao); carregar com manage.py carregar_exame_curso

perguntas.pergunta: Hello, {nome}. Welcome to your A1.2 speaking exam. Tell me about your job. What do you do every day?
perguntas.simples: What's your job? What do you do at work?

perguntas.pergunta: What are you working on this week?
perguntas.simples: This week, at work, what are you doing?

perguntas.pergunta: What do you like doing in your free time?
perguntas.simples: Do you like music? Sport? Cooking?

perguntas.pergunta: What can you do well? Can you cook? Can you drive?
perguntas.simples: Can you swim? Can you cook?

perguntas.pergunta: Now tell me about last weekend. What did you do?
perguntas.simples: Last Saturday, where were you? What did you do?

perguntas.pergunta: And next week? What are you going to do?
perguntas.simples: Next weekend, what are you going to do?

perguntas.pergunta: When's your next holiday, or a special day for you? What are you going to do?

notas: If the student answers a question with one word, ask Can you tell me more? once.
After the question about last weekend, ask one follow-up from the answer: Who were you with? Was it good? What did you eat?
If the student does not work, ask: What do you do every day? and This week, what are you doing?
If the student prefers not to talk about their personal life, accept it and ask: What did you do at work last week?
Use only language from units 1 to 10: no present perfect, no past continuous, no will.

tarefa.80-100: Answers everything, tells the past with details, says plans and solves the situation without help.
tarefa.60-79: Answers most questions; past and plans appear, even if short; solves the situation with some repetition.
tarefa.40-59: Answers about half; the past or the plans are missing; the situation is left half done.
tarefa.0-39: Answers few questions, or answers in Portuguese.

gramatica.80-100: Uses the four A1 tenses almost always correctly (did/didn't with the base verb, be in going to and in -ing); there is/are and can correct.
gramatica.60-79: Uses the four tenses with frequent mistakes in irregular verbs or did, but it is clear whether it is past, present or future.
gramatica.40-59: Almost only present; past and future are clear only from time words (yesterday, next week).

vocabulario.80-100: Uses the words of units 6-10 with ease and explains what they do not know (It's a kind of...).
vocabulario.60-79: Enough words; some pauses to find words.
vocabulario.40-59: Basic words are missing (food, places, days and months).
vocabulario.0-39: Very few words, or Portuguese words.

fluencia.80-100: Linked sentences (and, but, because, so, then), with few long pauses.
fluencia.60-79: Some linked sentences; frequent pauses, but keeps going.
fluencia.40-59: Separate, short sentences and long pauses.

nao_baixa: explaining a word with I don't know the word in English. It's a kind of...
one wrong irregular verb when the rest of the past is correct
-ed said as an extra syllable if the word is understood
